title: MacBrains Labs ANE Research Records
description:
Versioned, source-bound public research records from MacBrains Labs. Each version is a cumulative snapshot of the archive repository; v0.1.0 holds the original public measurement summaries, v0.2.0 the LFM3-1.7B layer-14 diagnostic record, v0.3.0 the ANERECore MIL parity record and v0.4.0 the Qwen2.5-1.5B Core ML compute-unit dispatch record. Version v0.5.0 adds the diagnostic record Published Qwen2.5-1.5B Core ML package against an fp32 reference of its original weights: the GPU output follows the reference for 7 tokens, the ANE output differs from the first token, and cpuOnly returns NaN in records/ane-record-e6d3d80e1ff7d9eb4614f6ad/.

Scope: same-chip, byte-reproducible on Apple A18 Pro (Mac17,5), macOS 27.3 (build 26C5047e), CoreML 3610.2.3; ANE execution INFERRED from Core ML compute-plan placement; no novelty claim. Hugging Face package NayteThaGreat/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-ANE at 7f9ab466 against an fp32 CPU reference of Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct at 989aa798, one prompt, greedy. The cause is unknown; the reference is not checked against PyTorch or transformers. Same-chip reruns are repeatability only, not cross-device replication. Four setup profiles, each committed before its first counted run: 20 runs logged device-wide, all counted, all passed, all disclosed. The record measures a model package that MacBrains Labs itself published on Hugging Face.

Records are reviewed summaries, not peer-reviewed results. The reported measurements have not been independently replicated by this deposit. Reviewed package SHA-256 e6d3d80e1ff7d9eb4614f6ad693ea4121150c86d5ac9045f0b94dc4081731013; reviewed record SHA-256 0e4d88d1039eb946913ef1f36bd75144eb59f4f99bbeccfeecc5c385f550b02d.
